routeSelection.basis: First current formal track; no official broadest/default/general route established. Chosen independently of UCR fit. First-year architectural project and later AUDE core form one coherent route; indicative Binder/Climber/Digger profiles are not additional compulsory tracks.

exception.reason: UCR offers related environmental, spatial and technical study, but its current courses do not sustain a sufficiently close response to the confirmed AUDE architectural and urban-design core. The strongest feasible climate-resilient built-environment response has substantive nature-based infrastructure, GIS/spatial and sustainability methods, materials/energy work and civic/cultural inquiry, but does not sustain the architectural spatial-organisation, building-program/typology, construction/detail and integrated housing/design sequence. This taught-content shortfall remains under the credible credit corrections.
exception.curriculumContext: The nominal degree is180EC. The25undisputed components shown total130EC. The multidisciplinary project is published as5or10EC and elective volume as40or45EC; their allocation remains unreconciled. The omitted50EC of the nominal degree are not all unknown required study or open electives: they contain the disputed project and the genuine but unreconciled elective allocation.
exception.ucrCourseEvidence: Current actual24-course strongest-response trial passes180EC,7advanced,year-onePPD,offerings and earlier prerequisites. BuildingwithNature/Water, materials/wave/chemistry laboratories, spatialengineering/GIS, energy/circularity and consumer design receive full consideration. Renaissancearchitecture and civic archaeology provide genuine contextual inquiry; no architectural-design, buildingstructure/HVAC or real-estate development sequence is invented.

audience.programmeDescription: Architecture, Urbanism and Building Sciences studies buildings and urban environments through design, technology, research and social and environmental inquiry. This example follows Architectural Urban Design and Engineering, with a sustained sequence of architectural and urban-design projects.
audience.comparisonExplanation: UCR offers related environmental, spatial and technical study, but its current courses do not sustain a sufficiently close response to the confirmed AUDE architectural and urban-design core. Related UCR environmental, infrastructure, spatial and sustainability courses do not supply the sustained architectural design and building-analysis sequence. The external credit-allocation conflict remains unresolved and is separate from this academic shortfall.
